responsibility: Defines s390x inline-assembly register classes and registers, including general, address, floating-point, vector, and access-register operands; emitted register syntax; reserved-register diagnostics; and overlap rules between vector registers and their aliased floating-point halves.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/s390x.rs`, this s390x file defines the inline `asm!` register space, including general/address/floating/vector/access-register operands, emitted `%` syntax, and overlap between `v0`-`v15` and `f0`-`f15`, instead of function-call ABI lowering.
